prompts.prompt:
[SCENE]
desk-workspace preset. Afternoon study session at a window-side wooden desk, warm late-afternoon sun streaming in from camera-left through a partially open window, approximately 3:30–4:30 PM golden hour quality. Raw oak wood grain desk surface, softly worn and lived-in.

[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
No product. Scene centers entirely on the hands and forearms as the subject.

[HUMAN ELEMENT]
Two hands and forearms only — no face, no torso, no full body visible. Person wears a relaxed heathered cotton hoodie, sleeve cuffs slightly pushed back to reveal forearms. Left hand rests open on a cream-white ruled notebook with a matte paper texture, pen loosely held between fingers. Right hand hovers lightly over a laptop keyboard, fingers naturally curved mid-type. Fingernails clean and unpolished. Natural skin texture, visible fine hand veins, no retouching.

[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Cream ruled notebook open to a written page, faint pencil margin lines visible. Matte aluminum laptop keyboard partially in frame, lower third. A ceramic mug with a thin rim sits softly out-of-focus at upper right edge. A single dried sprig of eucalyptus rests at the far corner of the desk. Soft afternoon dust motes visible in the light shaft from the window.

[LIGHTING]
45° camera-left natural window light, 5200K daylight neutral with slight golden drift toward 4800K from low sun angle. Large softbox diffusion quality — light behaves like a north-facing window caught in afternoon sun, wrapping gently over the backs of the hands. Soft falloff with gradient transition across the desk surface. Gentle wraparound from large diffused source fills the shadow side of the hands. Contact shadow only at base where hands rest on notebook and keyboard. No artificial strobe, no fill flash.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 85mm portrait, aperture f/2.8, shallow depth of field. Tack focus on the knuckles and finger joints of the left hand resting on the notebook. Laptop keyboard and mug fall into smooth bokeh. Slight natural lens breathing at edges.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Quiet, focused, intimate. Studious calm with a lived-in warmth — the feeling of a slow productive afternoon. Still air with soft dust motes drifting in the window light. Unhurried and wholesome.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Warm cream and raw oak neutrals as base. Heathered mid-grey hoodie fabric as anchor tone. Accents of pale eucalyptus sage. Low-contrast, muted, analog warmth. No oversaturated tones.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Brittany Ambridge, Pia Ulin, James Merrell. Editorial commercial photography.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Cinematic depth, hyper-realistic fabric texture on hoodie sleeve, natural hand skin details — fine lines, knuckle creases, subtle vein structure — no smoothing, no retouching. Film-like tonal gradation across highlights and shadows.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry,
no extra teeth, no melted facial features, no warped fingers or hands,
no plastic skin, no orange-tan skin, no over-smoothed retouching,
no doll eyes, no misaligned facial features, no rubber-like skin texture,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no visible text, no letters, no numbers, no words anywhere in the frame, no notebook writing legible enough to read, no screen text, no keyboard labels visible.

resolution: 2k
